principles: Settlement age and surviving historic character are separate layers.
A first map appearance proves 'present by' or 'first mapped', not an exact construction year.
Official designation polygons are imported rather than drawn from prose.
Historic harbour and shoreline geometry must be digitised separately for each verified map date.
Current HES records are authoritative for designation status.
warning: The historic-character score is interpretive and is not an official assessment of significance, condition or planning merit.
